notes: The apodosis waw goes `unrepresented`; the ASV opens *the wicked is no more* with no connective (rule 14).
*is no more* is kept whole with the existential אֵין and headed on *no* under rule 50.
יְסוֹד עוֹלָם is rendered attributively, so the single supplied *an* is the construct noun's under rules 28 and 29.
